title: Left properness when every object is cofibrant
statement: Let $\mathcal M$ be a model category in the terminology of [lem-coef-simplicial-model-nerve-localization]; no simplicial enrichment is required. Suppose every object is cofibrant, meaning that its map from the initial object is a cofibration. Then $\mathcal M$ is left proper: for every cofibration $i:A\to B$ and weak equivalence $w:A\to A^{\prime}$, the induced map $B\to B\amalg_A A^{\prime}$ is a weak equivalence.
